programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot
governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, PLANS, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
shooting_axiom: GOOD SHOOTING IS CONTINUOUS PERCEPTUAL COUPLING BETWEEN TARGET AND GUN: READ THE LINE -> MATCH THE SPEED -> APPLY THE METHOD -> TRIGGER -> FOLLOW THROUGH.
anti_cheat_audit_status: GREEN_THROUGH_L3_GEOMETRY_TIME_ALIGNMENT_AND_FRESH_REWARD_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTIC; LEARNER CONTROLLERS HAVE NO ORACLE OR PHYSICS-SCORING IMPORT; PROCESS CALIBRATION USES NO ORACLE SCORE; TARGET_LINE_GEOMETRY_AND_FRAME_STATE_TIME_ALIGNMENT_ARE_EXPLICITLY_AUDITED; REFEREE SCORES ONLY AFTER TRIGGER; MISS_DISTANCE_RANGE_FUTURE_PATH_INTERCEPT_PELLET_TOF_METRIC_LEAD_SEED_AND_DIRECT_CORRECTION_REMAIN OUTSIDE_CONTROLLER_AND_MEMORY
active_hypotheses: Good shooting is continuous perceptual coupling: read the live line, match gun speed, apply method, trigger, and follow through.
A demonstrated clay is a presentation prior rather than a deterministic trajectory; each live clay must be re-read as it varies with launch/aerodynamic/wind disturbance.
Maintained lead requires a dynamic 2D target-line relationship rather than a single scalar horizontal separation.

The corrected tangent/normal geometry and timestamp alignment are now green, so the next controlled question is whether the coarse 55-point shooter-visible relationship grid is artificially preventing sparse binary reward discovery.
A deterministic low-discrepancy sampling of the same existing shooter-visible relationship bounds can test quantisation without using oracle miss gradients or mathematical intercept information.

If quasi-continuous relationship exploration still produces no reward, a constant maintained-lead relationship may be insufficient and the next representation should allow shooter-visible phase-dependent relationship trajectories.
Human kinematic limits, follow-through duration, coupling tolerances and timing values remain SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS / PROVISIONAL_METHOD_KINEMATICS pending Sense/video calibration.
negative_findings: Static one-dimensional maintained-lead separation had no binary reward support after expanded diagnosis; motor travel was not the primary limitation.

L3 had been over-projecting delayed observations by 40 ms because a 120 ms belief horizon was used for an 80 ms-old observation while motor anticipation was also applied separately; this semantic bug is fixed.
After the timing fix the static representation still produced zero hits, so the fix did not manufacture success.
The first dynamic-coupling diagnostic was under-triggered at 5/550; process-only diagnostics showed the original relationship-stability threshold suppressed exploration.
A distinct process-only calibration removed trigger scarcity without using oracle outcomes, producing 50/550 physical follow-through shots, but still zero proxy hits.

Shooter-visible trigger timing expansion produced 100 physical follow-through shots across 1512 attempts and 126 relationship/timing actions but still zero proxy hits; timing inside the planned break region alone is therefore not supported as the missing ingredient.
The learner-side geometry/time-alignment audit found and fixed a 16.7 ms frame/state mismatch; the complete L0->L3 suite is green with the correction.

A fresh post-fix non-sealed diagnostic on seed base 351000 produced zero engineering-proxy hits across 660 attempts despite physical trigger and follow-through support; corrected geometry alone therefore does not establish binary reward support.

Do not widen the hit proxy, inject referee miss gradients, expose oracle lead, or scale to 100k until binary reward support exists in a scientifically defensible shooter-visible action representation.
next_action: Execute L3_CONTINUOUS_RELATIONSHIP_EXPLORATION_REWARD_SUPPORT_V1. Keep the corrected controller, finite plant, 55 mm engineering proxy and process-only trigger calibration fixed. Add a deterministic predeclared low-discrepancy/quasi-continuous sampling of the SAME existing shooter-visible forward/line-normal relationship bounds for diagnostic exploration, defined without consulting range, miss distances, intercepts or required lead. Use a fresh non-sealed bank identical across actions, score only post-trigger binary outcomes, retain the coarse 55-point grid as a negative baseline, and preserve anti-cheat tests. If binary support appears, freeze the sampling design and proceed to actual hit/miss learning rather than tuning around the rewarded point. If reward remains absent, move to shooter-visible phase-dependent relationship trajectories before any 100k scaling.
